# Project Governance 4.6.2

## Preserve publication protections

Foreground checks continue observing their original run through transient worker acknowledgment or result-publication gaps. Genuine failures, recorded orchestration errors, the original observation bound and native cleanup remain authoritative; a gap does not start another check.

Normal Git pre-push forwards an operator-selected `GOVERNANCE_PRE_PUSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` through the existing deadline validator. Its numeric bounds and absent-setting default remain unchanged. The first-push preparation and private-safe comparison diagnostics from 4.6.1 remain included.

## Exhaustive scanning with bounded Git batches

Immutable secret-scan inputs stream through bounded Git batches instead of one process per blob. Live files, staged-only content and the complete committed candidate remain covered. Strict object identity, type, length and delimiter checks, replacement-ref isolation and owned process cleanup preserve failure behavior.

## Installation and qualification

This stable maintenance release includes the bundled runtime and matching Cowork plugin ZIP. Use the normal deliberate, backed installation process at an owning idle seam. Publication does not change existing pins, task bindings, readers, checkouts or shared startup authority.

Qualification uses the normal local proof and manual publication process. Affected source tests and the actual installed archive verify normal hook budgets, foreground observation, scanner framing and exhaustive coverage, including failure and cleanup controls. Unchanged source and package evidence is retained after correspondence checks. GitHub CI is not used. Synthetic proof does not establish a live adopter rollout, new physical-host qualification or ordinary task acceptance.
